_comment: Copy to gates.config.json at INIT. Fill suiteCmd (project-details #TOOL-3) and unitIdRegex (project-details #CL-2). All gate scripts read this flat config; nothing is hardcoded to a stack. Every path/glob is relative to the PROJECT ROOT (the git top-level; override with projectRoot, relative to the spine dir, for a non-git layout).
_paths_plan_comment: Optional paths.plan: the Stage-4 test-plan glob for coverage_check --plan. Unset, it follows paths.spec (last segment *X -> *plan*X, so spec/**/*.body.html gives spec/**/*plan*.body.html).
_testGlobs_comment: One glob dialect everywhere (coverage_check, test_edit_ban, the plugin hook): ** spans directories, * does not, anchored at the project root. List test RUNNER CONFIG and snapshots too — an Engineer who can edit jest.config or a .snap can silence a test without touching it. The same holds for linter, mutation and architecture-checker config: listed here, it freezes with the tests. Add tsconfig.json, .editorconfig, Directory.Build.props or setup.cfg when they carry analyzer settings (they also carry build settings, so they are not listed by default). Config inside pyproject.toml or package.json cannot be split out - ban suppressions with a constitutionRules row instead.
_testTagExcludeGlobs_comment: Files under testGlobs whose @clause: tags do NOT count as coverage (notes, fixtures described in prose).
_structureGlobs_comment: Structure shards: the PM-approved member-level class diagrams (mermaid classDiagram in a content-only shard). Frozen with the tests (structure_check --frozen; the plugin hook denies the engineer persona edits); forward-traced into paths.code at ship (structure_check). A deviation is [NEEDS-PO:structure] -> PM -> replace wholesale -> re-freeze.

linkCheck._comment: link_check: skipGlobs are project-root globs for relative links that point at repo files, not shards (e.g. docs/**). A link whose target, resolved against the linking shard (a leading / is the project root), matches one is out of scope; every other relative link must name a shard. A raw-HTML spec also sets structureGlobs to **/*.structure.body.html.

_buildPlan_comment: Stage 4b build plan + read ledger (token_ledger). glob finds <ITEM-ID>.buildplan.md; tokensPerChar is the estimate used for every token number the ledger reports (chars x 0.25 ~ 4 chars/token) - an estimate, never a billed count.
_baseRef_comment: Fallback only. test_edit_ban diffs the QA-frozen SHA (passed by the Orchestrator / CI, mirrored in gates/.frozen by gates/freeze.*); a branch name here is warned as weak.
suiteCmd: <from project-details #TOOL-3 — e.g. dotnet test or npm test>
checkCmd: <from project-details #TOOL-7 — lint + type-check + format check, e.g. ruff check . && mypy src; or none>

staticCheck._comment: static_check (REQUIRED via checkCmd: unset = exit 2, "none" opts out on the record). findingRegex + baseline = the brownfield ratchet: count output lines matching findingRegex, FAIL above baseline, note to lower it below; an exit code outside findingExitCodes (default [0, 1]) is a tool error. Commands are one line, run under sh -c and cmd /c alike. fileCmd = the Claude Code plugin's per-edit feedback: run on each edited file under fileGlobs (default paths.code), {file} = its root-relative path, already quoted (write it bare); findings go back to the agent at once, the edit stands. See gates/README.md.

mutation._comment: mutation_check (optional; unset cmd = "not configured"). cmd from project-details #TOOL-8; {base} = the QA-frozen SHA, to mutate only the diff. scoreRegex: the first matching line carries the score (its first number), compared with minScore; unset, the exit code decides. Surviving mutants route to QA (Stage 5). See gates/README.md.

foldCheck._comment: Mode B: backlogRoot is searched for <unit-id>* files, or a heading/anchor naming the unit inside a file; it may also name one backlog file. Mode A: set resolveCmd with {unit} placeholder, e.g. 'scripts/jira.sh get {unit}'. Omit both to degrade to syntactic pin validation.

board._comment: Optional stage board (board/README.md): sprint membership, GUIDE stage and team per backlog item, in a git-tracked JSON file. file unset = off (board_check: not configured; Mode A uses the tracker's own board). The backlog is foldCheck.backlogRoot (a directory of item files, or one file of rows); store.root overrides it, store.closed names a completed-rows file to move shipped rows into. Stage ids come from PROCESS.md's Stage Index; stageLabels and columns shape the board; dispatch maps a persona's subagent_type to the stage the plugin hook sets when it is dispatched with a 'Board: <KEY>' brief line. meta (optional) = a JSON file of {KEY: {e: epic, f: S|M|L|XL, st, t}}; epics = [{id, name, desc}] for the page's epic panel.

proseCheck._comment: SDD-PROP-09 spec form (prose_check). mode: warn (default) | strict (violations FAIL; migrate-on-contact) | off. maxParaShare = max fraction of a shard's words in paragraph text; maxParaWords = longest single paragraph; minWords = shards below this skip the share test (the paragraph test still applies); excludeGlobs = generated shards to ignore.

_constitutionRules_comment: Example: {id:'no-hardcoded-ui', kind:'must_not_match', paths:'src/**/*.tsx', pattern:'>[A-Z][a-z]+ ', message:'...'}. Author one rule per project principle. See gates/README.md.
_seamRules_comment: Example: {id:'SEAM-1-audit', kind:'pair_requires', paths:'src/**/Handlers/**/*.cs', pattern:'ICommandHandler', expect:'IAuditSink', message:'...'}. Prefer a real checker where the stack has one: {id:'SEAM-3-layers', kind:'command', cmd:'lint-imports', message:'...'} (exit 0 passes; import-linter, dependency-cruiser, ArchUnit tests...). Author one rule per Project Details SEAM-N. See gates/README.md.
_qaImportRules_comment: Example: {id:'qa-no-impl-import', kind:'must_not_match', paths:'tests/**/*.cs', pattern:'using\s+MyApp\.Internal', message:'QA tests may not import production internals'}. (In the real rule, write the pattern as JSON: "using\\s+MyApp\\.Internal".) Read by qa_import_ban (copy qa_import_ban.template.* to a concrete name); the copied gate FAILS (exit 2) while this array is empty. Same rule shape as constitutionRules/seamRules. See gates/README.md.
